subject: Coverage wave: use typed pairwise/3-wise composition to exercise all 91 Powers and registered Format Commons families

body.objective: Maximize real interaction coverage without a combinatorial explosion of isolated demos.
required_actions: Read the live 91-Power registry and typed compatibility/dependency graph. Every Power must end in exercised_real, exercised_replay, blocked_exactly, or redundant_by_proof; no unclassified entries.

Generate a pairwise covering array across compatible Power families and 3-wise coverage for high-risk crossings such as authority+effect+external, model+context+receipt, storage+format+deletion, and Frappe+provider+projection.
Use the YaFF/HVM2 compiled capability graph to reject nonsensical combinations and prefer compositions that also close current WorkGraph obligations.

For Format Commons, execute tiny round-trip representatives across every registered family first, then expand to all cheap registered targets through generated property tests. Content-address each artifact before and after round-trip and validate semantic equivalence plus format-native validator where available.
Cross-link Power coverage with the nine Frappe lineages, Model Commons and Partner Commons so coverage comes from company workflows rather than a separate test museum.
Persist a coverage heatmap with receipts and invalidation keys. New/changed Powers automatically reopen only the affected cells.
body.resource_fence: Keep fixtures tiny; no large media/model generation solely for coverage. Coverage quality is interaction/receipt depth, not output size.
